FROM ref_fiscal_calendar

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) as total_gross_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipts,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) as total_gross_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as avg_transaction_value
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

SELECT DISTINCT channel_code, COUNT(*) as count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY channel_code
ORDER BY channel_code

SELECT DISTINCT channel_id, COUNT(*) as count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY channel_id
ORDER BY channel_id

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.format,
  MIN(f.gross_amount) as min_transaction,
  MAX(f.gross_amount) as max_transaction,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.gross_amount <= 0 THEN 1 END) as zero_or_negative_transactions,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.gross_amount > 1000 THEN 1 END) as large_transactions
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND f.channel_id = 1
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format
